name: Zvychajnyj den'
source:
One night can change everything.

When you open your eyes, you do not know what reality will meet you in the morning whiteness of a new day. No one understands what happened to our city. Too many rumors are spread in a concerted attempt to grasp reality, while [b]they[/b] [u][i]follow[/i][/u]. Almost from every house and pillar. A flesh infection spreads through the city, consuming it along with the inhabitants who were left alone with this horror.

[Translated from [url=https://ellenfry.itch.io/zvychday]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一晚可以改变一切。

当你睁开眼睛时，你不知道在新的一天的晨光中，现实会是什么样子。没有人了解我们的城市发生了什么。太多的谣言被散布，试图抓住现实，而[b]他们[/b][u][i]跟随[/i][/u]。几乎来自每一座房屋和柱子。一种肉体感染在整个城市蔓延，连同那些独自承受这种恐怖的居民一起吞噬了这座城市。

[译自[url=https://ellenfry.itch.io/zvychday]itch.io[/url]]
